Market today: The market is feeling nervous about a potential Fed rate hike, which could hit growth-oriented tech and chip names hard. The AI trade faces a test with Oracle earnings next week, while some see strong economic prospects driving yields up.

Your holdings: SOXL is down a massive -58.43% and flagged SELL; as a leveraged ETF, this decay is amplified. SPAL, a brand-new leveraged ETF, is already down -39.6% and also decays. QQQ, SMH, and QQQI are all flagged TRIM. Remember, trading on margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on next week's Oracle earnings for clues on the AI trade's strength. Also, monitor any further Fed commentary on interest rates.

Bottom line: It's time to seriously consider reducing risk in your leveraged and underperforming tech/chip positions given the rate hike jitters.
plays: Seriously consider trimming or exiting SOXL given the -58.43% loss and its leveraged, decaying nature.
Review SPAL, a new leveraged ETF, down -39.6%. Consider if this position aligns with your risk tolerance.
Respect the TRIM status on QQQ, SMH, and QQQI to reduce overall portfolio risk.
